plugins.name: tisty
plugins.description: Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: tasks with steps and a dated journal, Markdown documents and Brainstorm ideas, on your own disk. Your agent picks up where it left off and reads a section at a time, where you can follow and audit it. Needs the free Tisty app for Windows or macOS.
